info.title: Overleaf API Reference
info.description: Public REST endpoints exposed by this Overleaf deployment that external clients can call: the Git Bridge API, the Personal Access Token API used to create the tokens that authenticate API requests, the MCP REST API, and the OAuth2 authorization server used by MCP clients. Only endpoints of features enabled on this deployment are listed.

bearerAuth.description: A personal access token created via POST /user/personal-access-tokens, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Basic auth (token as the username or password) and a query-string access_token parameter are also accepted for git compatibility.

sessionAuth.name: overleaf_session2
sessionAuth.description: An authenticated browser session, for callers already logged into the web UI.

mcpBearerAuth.description: Either a personal access token created with the 'mcp' scope, or an OAuth2 access token (JWT) issued by /oauth/token. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Requests are rate limited to 200 per minute per token, and 60 per minute per client IP before authentication.

srcs.description: Text file entries as [content, path] pairs.

atts.description: Binary attachment entries as [url, path] pairs. The URL is a short-lived, project+file-scoped signed link to the file endpoint below.

McpError.description: Error envelope. HTTP status by code: unauthorized 401, insufficient_scope 403, forbidden 403, not_found 404, validation_error 400, rate_limited 429, upstream_error 502.

rootDocId.description: Id of the main document, or null if none is set.

error.description: OAuth error code, e.g. invalid_request, invalid_grant, invalid_client_metadata, invalid_redirect_uri, unsupported_grant_type, invalid_target, slow_down.

access_token.description: JWT to send as a Bearer token. Valid for 1 hour.

expires_in.description: Lifetime of the access token in seconds.

refresh_token.description: Use with grant_type=refresh_token to obtain a new access token.

get.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization server metadata (RFC 8414). MCP clients use it to discover the other endpoints.
Returns the same metadata document as /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.
JSON Web Key Set used to verify access tokens. Cached for 24 hours.

post.description: Dynamic client registration (RFC 7591). Registers a public client that uses PKCE. Registering the same name and redirect URIs again returns the existing client. Rate limited to 60 requests per minute per client IP.

400.description: Invalid client metadata or redirect URI

redirect_uris.description: HTTPS URLs, or http://localhost / http://127.0.0.1 for local clients. No user info allowed.

get.description: Open this URL in the user's browser. The user signs in to Overleaf if needed and approves access; the browser is then redirected to redirect_uri with a code and the state you sent. Exchange the code at /oauth/token. Only response_type=code with PKCE (S256) is supported.

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: One of the client's registered redirect URIs.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Opaque value returned unchanged to redirect_uri.

302.description: Redirect to redirect_uri with an error and the state, if the request is invalid.

post.summary: Exchange a code or refresh token for an access token
post.description: Send the request body as application/x-www-form-urlencoded or JSON. Use grant_type=authorization_code with the code and PKCE verifier, or grant_type=refresh_token. Rate limited to 60 requests per minute per client IP.

redirect_uri.description: Must match the redirect_uri used to authorize (authorization_code grant).

resource.description: Optional audience the token is requested for.

tags.name: Git Bridge
tags.description: Read and write project content over HTTP for the git-bridge integration. Authenticated with a personal access token.

tags.name: Personal Access Tokens
tags.description: Create, list and revoke the tokens that authenticate Git Bridge and MCP requests. These endpoints use your logged-in browser session.

tags.name: MCP OpenAPI
tags.description: The MCP service publishes its own summary OpenAPI document.

tags.name: MCP Projects
tags.description: List, create and configure projects. Authenticated with a personal access token or OAuth2 access token that has the mcp scope.

tags.name: MCP Files
tags.description: Browse, search, read, write, upload, move and download project files. Authenticated with a token that has the mcp scope.

tags.name: MCP Compile
tags.description: Compile a project and fetch its log, PDF, word count and SyncTeX positions. Authenticated with a token that has the mcp scope.

tags.name: OAuth2
tags.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization server (authorization code with PKCE) that issues access tokens to MCP clients.
